description: List campaigns. List mail campaigns for your organization with optional filtering. Each campaign has one of five statuses: draft, ready, active, paused or ended. Use accepting_properties=true to list the campaigns properties can be added to now. Retrieves data without changing records or spending credits.

accepting_properties.description: true returns only campaigns properties can be added to now (they accept properties and are ready, active or paused).

status.description: Filter by campaign status: draft, ready, active, paused or ended. The older values completed and cancelled still work and match the ended campaigns they matched before.

name: dealmachine_get_mail_campaigns
